title: Creamy Jazzy Risotto
description: A rich and flavorful risotto dish featuring jazzy ingredients and a touch of greek flair.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of greek in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add 1 cup of jazzy and sauté until fragrant.
Add 1 cup of risotto and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add 2 cups of rice and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add 4 cups of vegetable broth, 1 cup at a time, stirring constantly and allowing each portion to absorb before adding the next.
Continue cooking until the risotto is creamy and the rice is tender.
Remove from heat and let rest for 2-3 minutes.
